(I mountain bike a lot off-road.) Surprisingly the poppers help my rheumatoid arthritis (under control with gold shots).
Sexually, who says there is no fountain of youth?! So glad I'm gay so I can indulge in this delight. Of course anything not done in moderation can be harmful, but generally from what I have read there are no severe effects from responsible popper use.
